headline: ATL @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.46 at SDP 3.87, with a projected total of 8.33. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (ATL +0.20, SDP +0.12), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.32, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Martín Pérez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Samad Taylor, Mauricio Dubón, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ha-Seong Kim, Jase Bowen because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
